name: autocomplete-not-magic
displayName: Your AI Isn't Thinking. It's Autocomplete With a PhD.
description: A Built-in-the-Hive playbook: a generative model is powerful autocomplete that predicts the next word from patterns and context, so quality is engineered in the context around it, not wished into the model. Shows professional-services teams how to engineer context, grounding, tools, and guardrails to turn prediction into dependable automation. Built on Copilot Studio, Azure AI Search, Foundry, Power Automate, and Purview. An AI-literacy playbook.
